title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Protect sensitive data across agent-to-human and agent-to-tool interactions with expanded DLP controls across local agents
description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) now expands inline protection to supported local AI agents, helping safeguard sensitive data across human-to-agent and agent-to-tool interactions. Organizations can apply DLP policies to prompts, files, and tool interactions to block policy-violating data movement at supported interaction points. These controls help prevent sensitive data exposure as AI agents access enterprise information and act on users’ behalf.
